notes: Τὰ ἀδύνατα: the substantival article takes *The things* under rule 22 and the predicate adjective carries the supplied relativizer and copula, an adjective being a token able to carry them as rules 31, 53 and 92 have it. Giving *which* to the article is the competing reading.
The second clause's expressed ἐστιν takes *are*, so δυνατά stands alone.
